item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-25
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting updates recently. The `scienceverse/metacheck` project has introduced a new `reproducibility_check` feature, courtesy of Lakens, which enhances the tool's capabilities. Meanwhile, the `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing` project has released version 0.4.1, with updates to the `gh-pages` branch and a modification to the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js` on the `master` branch. These developments demonstrate the connections between our projects, with a focus on reproducibility and user experience. As our community continues to grow and collaborate, we celebrate the progress made and look forward to the impact of these updates on our research endeavors. With these advancements, we're strengthening the foundation for more reliable and effective research tools.

5 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
